answer: A person is one proof, not a hundred: Colour grinder dye cake proof dyed in the steeping room, with the record each dye cake is a season of logged dye readings plus a signed dye record to show for it. The verification trail is short enough to audit by hand and long enough to catch a farm. The farm rehearsed the orchard, it rehearsed the vertex, but it never rehearsed the island, because a year cannot be rehearsed. Locking 147 POA per alias means a farm of 189 aliases must park 27783 POA before the epoch even opens.
